links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified Epic/Elsevier orthopaedic PEMs (baseline mean grade 8.6 English, 5.8 Spanish); human easy-to-read versions used for fidelity comparison
links.outcome: Reading grade level of patient education materials
links.effect: Mean reading grade fell from 8.6 to 6.1 in English and from 5.8 to 3.5 in Spanish with ChatGPT-4o simplification (806 PEMs).
links.tradeoff: Fidelity errors in 86 PEMs: ChatGPT-4o had higher Spanish hallucinations than human simplifications, though fewer English omissions and fewer inconsistencies in both languages. Authors recommend clinician-supervised use.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o-simplified PEMs showed mean reading grade levels of 6.1 in English and 3.5 in Spanish.

design_hint: reading-level constrained simplification prompts with blinded clinician fidelity review
